dogecoin.text: What if #dogecoin is being employed cynically to demoralize the #cryptocurrency market? It wouldn't demoralize most #Bitcoin maxis (they're too tough), or majority #bitcoin hodlers (similar toughness), but if you use unlimited fiat to boost a useless asset to ludicrous heights..
@crypto_birb All the central banker, environmental, etc FUD didn't start the bear market, but normies putting billions into $doge after @elonmusk tweets, and everyone getting rekt might just do it...

Sorry, everyone is going to have an opinion on what bags you hold, not all of them are good, and you deal; that's life.
